name: Arduino boards (Uno, Mega 2560, Leonardo)
summary: Genuine Arduino boards appear as a standard USB modem (CDC ACM) serial port.

linux.notes: Shows up as /dev/ttyACM0. If the Arduino IDE says "permission denied", your account needs to be in the dialout group; Plug Doctor fixes that.

darwin.notes: Shows up as /dev/cu.usbmodem*. No driver needed.

win32.notes: Shows up as a COM port. Windows 10 and later need no driver.
